components.name: Icon Button

components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.2); border-radius: 50%; color: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.9); background: rgba(8, 7, 6, 0.28); box-shadow: 0 14px 44px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.24); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-icon-button:hover { border-color: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.42); color: #f7efe5; background: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.1); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e3b35f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

components.css: .ds-recipe-sheet { overflow: hidden; max-width: 900px; border: 1px solid rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.16); border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0; color: #f7efe5; background: rgba(12, 10, 9, 0.88); box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); } .ds-sheet-header { padding: 22px 24px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.1); } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #e3b35f; font: 700 0.78rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-sheet-header h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem)/0.95 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-sheet-content { display: grid; gap: 22px; padding: 20px 24px 26px; } .ds-description { margin: 0; color: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.82); line-height: 1.7; } .ds-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin: 0; } .ds-meta div { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.12); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.05); } .ds-meta dt { margin-bottom: 5px; color: #e3b35f; font: 700 0.7rem Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-meta dd { margin: 0; color: rgba(247, 239, 229, 0.86); font-size: 0.9rem; }

narrative.overview:
Just One Sip is a poster-first cocktail surface. The daily drink should feel staged under low bar light: full-bleed imagery, warm cream type, a gold cue for orientation, and compact controls that stay out of the frame until needed.

The system is brand-first, not workflow-first. Utility exists in tight layers: icon tools, small menus, a bottom recipe sheet, and a visual archive. Avoid AI-template cliches, generic hero/card grids, purple gradients, decorative glassmorphism, and feature-marketing copy.
keyCharacteristics: Image-led immersive viewports with text placed directly over the poster scene.
Warm dark neutrals, cream text, bitter red atmosphere, and vermouth-gold labels.
Georgia display type for cocktail names, system sans for clear recipe and UI text.
Compact circular icon controls, pill handles, and 8px content cards.
Bilingual title fitting and mobile overflow prevention are core brand constraints.

rules.name: The Bar-Light Rule
rules.body: Gold is a cue, not a wash. Use it for labels, dates, and the single strongest action, not for broad panels.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never introduce pure `#000` or `#fff`; every dark and light should stay tinted toward the existing warm palette.

rules.name: The Natural Break Rule
rules.body: Do not force hard word breaking. CJK and single-word titles prefer one line; multi-word names may wrap only at natural breaks.

rules.name: The Label Rarity Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels are for orientation and recipe metadata only. Do not turn every section into a label-plus-heading pattern.

rules.name: The Legibility Layer Rule
rules.body: Shade, blur, and shadow are allowed only where imagery would otherwise damage text or control clarity.

dos: Do keep the home and detail pages poster-first with full-bleed imagery.
Do use Charred Walnut, Cream Ink, Vermouth Gold, and Bitter Ruby as the core system colors.
Do keep icon controls compact and labeled for assistive technology.
Do preserve bilingual title fitting and avoid horizontal overflow on mobile.
Do use blur, shade, and shadow only as legibility layers over imagery.
donts: Don't use AI-template cliches: generic hero/card-grid patterns, purple gradients, decorative glassmorphism, feature-marketing copy, repeated icon-card sections, or empty visual decoration.
Don't introduce a sterile recipe-app layout where the visual becomes secondary.
Don't use pure black or pure white.
Don't add colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, oversized rounded icon cards, or nested cards.
Don't add SSR, database, CMS, API, or schedule-dependent server behavior for visual-system work.
